text:
marta_procure: Heads up — Bolt sent RMA for 48 GPU units (RA# BOLT-9082). They propose a split replacement: 24 units air to the US for fast recovery, 24 units sea to EU warehouse. They want to invoice replacements separately and apply credit for DOA units after customs release. Need clarity on lead times, customs docs, and how/when the credit hits our account.

jesse_infra: What's the immediate impact on Dedicated pools? If EU replacements are sea only, we could see a capacity gap in eu-west-1. Do we have spare headroom or should we temporarily shift traffic?

anita_ops: Short answer — expect ~12% capacity dip in eu-west-1 if 24 units are delayed 2+ weeks. We can throttle batch and shift latency-sensitive traffic. :thinking_face:

lucy_logistics: I'm coordinating customs/shipping. Bolt gave provisional AWBs for the air leg: `AWB: 337-ABC-998` and `AWB: 337-ABC-999` (pending pickup). ETA air ~48h after pickup, sea booking not confirmed yet (12–18 days transit). For split shipments we need proforma invoices + HS codes and a vendor warranty letter or customs may hold.

marta_procure: Bolt's RMA note says they'll deduct 3% handling unless we accept consolidated return (which pushes sea only). Can we push for full credit? Eddie, any objections on finance side?

eddie_fin: We can tolerate a 3% handling deduction if it avoids an extra ~$12k air bill. Quick math: air expedite for 24 units adds ~+$12k; sea adds ~$1.2k. Splitting air for 24 is ~+$6k + handling. If we can consolidate some workloads to US temporarily, that might be cheaper than absorbing full expedite.

rma_bot: RMA logged: id `BOLT-RMA-9082` — status: vendor-confirmed — items: 48x A100-80GB — allocated replacements: 24 (air, US), 24 (sea, EU).

lucy_logistics: Important customs note: vendor suggested declaring replacement value as $1/unit and marking as "replacement under warranty". That reduces duties but sometimes triggers extra inspection. I recommend attaching the RMA letter + PO reference to avoid delays. Also need our EORI and US broker details.

marta_procure: Our PO# is 5421 — our EU EORI: `GB999999999000`. Please add reference. Also confirm whether Bolt will prepay the air AWB or we need to handle freight collect.

lucy_logistics: Bolt offered prepaid for the air leg if we accept the 3% handling fee. If we decline handling fee, they want freight collect and will invoice shipping separately. Suggestion: accept prepaid air for the 24 urgent units to minimize downtime, and take sea for the remainder.

jesse_infra: Fine from infra side if we get the 24 air in 48–72h. I'll prepare routing plan: canary shift 70% to US pools with telemetry. If air slips >72h, we'll fallback to reduced model config (quantized profile) to conserve tokens.

anita_ops: Can ops schedule canary for Thu morning? That gives 48h buffer. Also need runbooks updated for cross-region failover (I can update).

marta_procure: Eddie — if we accept prepaid air + 3% handling, can finance approve? Also need clarity on when the DOA credit posts. Bolt says credit posts after customs release and local QA check (3–5 business days).

eddie_fin: Approve prepaid air + 3% handling for headroom. But we need a vendor credit memo template in writing: credit amount = unit cost minus any agreed restocking/handling. Ask Bolt for a formal credit schedule tied to RMA id.

lucy_logistics: I'll request the credit memo and insist on vendor covering any customs fines from undervaluation. I'll also push Bolt to mark commercial invoice with replacement/warranty codes rather than undervalue only.

marta_procure: Also note vendor mentioned restocking premium for returns >30 days. Our RMA timeline shows replacements should be <20 days; call them out on restocking for this case. I pinged Marco (Bolt) for written confirmation.

lucy_logistics: Shipping snippet for records (internal):
```
AWB_AIR_1=337-ABC-998
AWB_AIR_2=337-ABC-999
SHIP_TYPE=replacement_under_warranty
PO_REF=5421
RMA_ID=BOLT-RMA-9082
```

anita_ops: Thanks — once air AWB is active, ping here and I'll trigger canary. :white_check_mark:

jesse_infra: I'll prepare the routing change and a short rollback plan. Who will monitor the telemetry?

marta_procure: Anita will own monitoring, Jesse handles the route change, Lucy keeps shipping/comms with Bolt, Eddie watches finance. I'll keep pressure on Bolt for the credit memo and restocking waiver.

lucy_logistics: One more note — customs agents sometimes request full vendor commercial invoice regardless of "replacement" marking. I'll ask Bolt to provide both a full commercial invoice and a separate warranty letter to speed clearance.

marta_procure: Ok. Action items: Lucy to get vendor credit memo + confirm prepaid/collect for air; Bolt to provide commercial invoice + warranty letter; Jesse/Anita to prep canary for Thu; Eddie to OK the 3% handling. Update here when AWB status changes.

eddie_fin: Approved on my end. Keep receipts for reconciliation.

marta_procure: Thanks team. Ping Marco again now. :phone: 

rma_bot: Note: thread updated with vendor response placeholder (waiting for Marco/Bolt to attach credit memo).
